title: Topic 2
japanese_text: <ruby>一人暮<rt>ひとりぐ</rt></ruby>らしを<ruby>始<rt>はじ</rt></ruby>めたばかりなので、<ruby>家<rt>いえ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>中<rt>なか</rt></ruby>はまだ<ruby>全然<rt>ぜんぜん</rt></ruby><ruby>片付<rt>かたづ</rt></ruby>いていない。<ruby>早<rt>はや</rt></ruby>く<ruby>必要<rt>ひつよう</rt></ruby>な<ruby><u>家具</u><rt>かぐ</rt></ruby>をそろえて、<ruby><u>家事</u><rt>かじ</rt></ruby>にも<ruby>慣<rt>な</rt></ruby>れたいと<ruby>思<rt>おも</rt></ruby>う。
english_translation: Since I just started living alone, I haven't cleaned up my home at all yet. I want to hurry up and get all the furniture I need and get used to doing housework.
